description: Weekly U.S. Drought Monitor drought-severity statistics for the nation: percent of area or percent of population in categories None, D0 (abnormally dry) through D4 (exceptional drought). Categories are cumulative (D1+ means D1 through D4 combined, i.e. 'at least moderate drought'). Covers the contiguous 48 states (conus), the contiguous states plus Alaska/Hawaii/Puerto Rico (total), or both at once (us). Published weekly — map valid every Tuesday, released the following Thursday. Omit dates for the latest available map.

area.description: conus = contiguous 48 states only. total = contiguous states plus Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico. us = both rows at once. Default conus.

end_date.description: Latest map date, YYYY-MM-DD or M/D/YYYY. Omit for the latest single map.

measure.description: 'area' = percent of land area in each category (default). 'population' = percent of the area's population in each category.

start_date.description: Earliest map date, YYYY-MM-DD or M/D/YYYY. Omit for the latest single map.

name: us_drought_national
title: Us Drought National
